evidence.observation: O2 reverses its purge-down trend and rises monotonically 13.5→54.5 ppm during growth
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the O2 rise is not from a flow change
Pressure gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere/leak cannot be directly confirmed
Temperature holds at setpoint 750°C, heater power nominal

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) or an Ar-flow step/leak-up test to distinguish an air ingress leak from an O2 sensor drift or exhaust backflow.
